comments.text: IF you could visit only one place in Pakistan, where would you go? K2, the Hunza Valley, the ancient ruins of Mohenjo-daro, or the bustling streets of Lahore?

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: Great question! 😊 I'd probably choose the Hunza Valley for its incredible mountain scenery, but honestly, each of those places offers something unique. Thanks for sharing! 🇵🇰
